capabilities: Preview notes as styled WeChat article HTML in a sidebar
Send articles to a WeChat Official Account draft box
Export standalone HTML with embedded local images
Copy formatted HTML and plain text to the clipboard
Generate title suggestions and AI covers via an OpenAI-compatible provider
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not an AI writing editor; the AI features are optional title and cover generation on top of a WeChat formatting and publishing tool.
extras: Interface is primarily in Chinese; WeChat AppSecret and AI API keys are stored unencrypted in data.json (warning documented); LaTeX formula rendering is not implemented; mobile clipboard support is unverified in this release candidate.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to render notes as WeChat-styled article HTML or push drafts to the WeChat Official Account draft API.

relations.evidence: The reading workbench takes interaction-design inspiration from Qiaomu Publish.
Code block rendering and WeChat HTML compatibility include code derived from sunbooshi/note-to-mp

requires.name: WeChat Official Account with AppID/AppSecret and draft/material API permissions

summary: Markdown-to-WeChat formatter that previews article HTML in a sidebar, applies themes, uploads local images, and sends drafts to a WeChat Official Account.
